works.title: Oh Madonna!
works.publicNote: One tune with two German texts by Ernst Marischka and Fritz Rotter. The song was published, and Hofmeister registered it in May 1933, as “Signorina! komm zu mir”, a 6/8 march-foxtrot; in the film, and on Jan Kiepura’s Odeon disc, it is sung as “Oh Madonna!”. A disc by Carl Jörken is titled “O signorina (O Madonna)” and sings the Madonna text, and the Polish version, “Signorina, signorina”, follows the printed title. The film’s programme prints the song as “Signorina! Serenade” with the words “O Madonna, o Madonna, komm zu mir”. The two were catalogued as separate works until November 2026.

works.title: Mein Gorilla hat ’ne Villa im Zoo
works.sortTitle: Mein Gorilla hat ’ne Villa im Zoo
works.publicNote: The lyric is signed “P. Kuckuck”. Behind the name stood Fritz Rotter, who is credited with the film’s lyrics and who wrote its two other songs under his own name, on prints where Kaper and Jurmann appeared as “Ernst Martin”; the publisher’s house history states that Rotter signed this one number under the pseudonym, in the year all three had to leave Germany. GEMA and the Library of Congress still register Peter Kuckuck as a name of its own.
